items.title: Alkanes aur cycloalkanes ki shaklein (print mein doosra 11.2.3) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Shapes of Alkanes and Cycloalkanes, printed as a second 11.2.3, pages 249-251.

blocks.text: Alkane ke carbon atom ke chaar sp³ hybridized orbitals hote hain aur woh chaar single bonds banata hai jo aik doosre se barabar faasle par hote hain (Figure 11.4). Is liye alkane molecules mein har carbon atom ke gird shape tetrahedral (chaar konon wali, teen-pehlu pyramid jaisi) hoti hai.
Alkane molecules mein carbon atoms apne ird gird ke carbon aur hydrogen atoms ke saath sigma bonds banate hain.

Is wajah se alkanes mein har carbon atom ke gird bonding electrons ke 4 pairs hote hain jo aik doosre ko barabar dhakelte (repel karte) hain. Is se 109.5° ke bond angles bante hain, aur C–C bond length 1.54 Å hoti hai. Organic molecules ki shapes aam taur par ball and stick formula (gend aur dandi wale model) se dikhai jati hain. Kuch seedhi chain wale alkanes ki shapes Table 11.4 mein hain.

blocks.alt: Orbital khaaka. Methane: darmiyani C se chaar neele sp3 lobes, har ek ke sire par peela H; do lobes ke darmiyan qaus par 109.5 degree; 'sp3 hybrid tetrahedral'. Ethane: do carbons, har ek ke teen lobes H tak, aur dono carbons ke darmiyan do lobes seedha (end-on) overlap karte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.4: sp3 hybridised methane aur ethane (kitab ki Figure 11.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Methane (oopar) aur ethane (neeche) ke ball-and-stick models. Methane mein chaar hydrogen carbon ke gird tetrahedron ke konon par hain, aur surkh qaus 109.5 degree ka bond angle dikhati hai. Ethane mein do carbon jamni C-C sigma bond se jure hain aur har carbon par teen hydrogen hain. Har C-H bond par naranji saaya sp3-s sigma overlap dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: sp3 hybridised methane aur ethane: hamara apna 3D model (kitab ki Figure 11.4 oopar 2D khaake mein hai; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Carbon apna 2s aur teen 2p orbitals mila kar chaar barabar sp3 orbitals banata hai jo tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf 109.5 degree ke fasle par hain. Methane mein har sp3 orbital hydrogen ke 1s orbital se seedha (end-on) overlap kar ke chaar C-H sigma bonds banata hai. Ethane mein har carbon ka aik sp3 orbital end-on overlap se C-C sigma bond banata hai aur baqi teen hydrogen se judte hain, kul chhe C-H sigma bonds.

fallback.text: Methane aur ethane: har carbon sp3 hai, us ke chaar sigma bonds tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf 109.5 degree ke fasle par hain.

blocks.text: Cycloalkanes cyclic hain, yani molecule ke carbon atoms aik halqe (ring) ki shakal mein lage hote hain. Cycloalkanes saturated bhi hain, yani halqe ke tamam carbon atoms doosre atoms se sirf single bonds se jure hain. Cyclopropane, cyclobutane aur cyclopentane ki shapes Table 11.5 mein hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Table 11.5 mein cyclopentane ka formula C₄H₁₀ chhapa hai. Cyclopentane ke halqe mein 5 carbon hain aur cycloalkane ka formula CₙH₂ₙ hota hai, is liye sahi formula C₅H₁₀ hai (C₄H₁₀ to butane hai).

items: Alkane ka carbon: sp³, chaar sigma bonds, tetrahedral, 109.5°, C–C 1.54 Å.
Cycloalkanes saturated halqe hain: cyclopropane C₃H₆, cyclobutane C₄H₈, cyclopentane C₅H₁₀.
